The '''Aggressor assault fighter''' was a high-performance [[starship]] produced by [[Trilon, Inc./Legends|Trilon, Inc.]]

==Characteristics==
[[File:IG2000-XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|A [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of Aggressor assault fighters]]
Easily identifiable by its insectile shape, the Aggressor was characterized by a thin V-shaped twin-decked hull,<ref name="TNEGtVaV" /> and made use of ailerons and [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering thrusters]] in conjunction with variable positioning to give the craft extremely high maneuverability.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" /><ref name="EGtVaV" /> The front of the craft was dominated by two flat mandibles, which served the purpose of housing some of the crafts weaponry, as well as acting as [[Docking clamp/Legends|magnetic docking clamps]].<ref name="TNEGtVaV" /><ref name="EGtVaV" />

[[File:InertialDampeners-XWM.png|thumb|right|200px|An Aggressor firing on a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol craft]]]]
[[IG-88B|IG-88]] showed the versatility of the Aggressor design by modifying the craft to its absolute limits.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" /> Under the direction of IG-88, the infamous Aggressor fighter [[IG-2000/Legends|IG-2000]] had its engine replaced with a [[Galaxy-15 ion engine/Legends|Galaxy-15 ion engine]] from an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], and was powered by three tandem [[Quadex power core]]s that fed directly into the ship's drives; further, the ship was modified with heavy shields, enhanced targeting arrays, and heavy armaments.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />

==History==
Aggressor assault fighters were used by [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] and by Jedi turned Mandalorian [[Bardan Jusik]]. One of the best known Aggressors was the [[IG-2000/Legends|''IG-2000'']], the personal starship of the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]].
